BETWEEN:-
 RAGHUVAAR SINGH S/O RAJENDRA SINGH, AGED

, OCCUPATION: STUDENT, R/O: WARD  NO.18, VILL. SEJAWTA, RATLAM, DIST. RATLAM  (MADHYA PRADESH)

AND  1. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH STATION  HOUSE OFFICER THROUGH POLICE STATION  INDUSTRIAL AREA, RATLAM, DISTRICT RATLAM  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 2. PROSECUTRIX X THROUGH P.S. INDUSTRIAL  AREA, DIST. RATLAM (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (MS. HARSHLATA SONI - PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

Applicant has filed this second bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 on behalf of the applicant for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.592/2022 registered at P.S. Industrial Area, Ratlam District Ratlam (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC and Section 5 (J)(ii)/6 of POCSO Act.
His earlier bail application was rejected on merit by this Court vide order dated 21.12.2022 passed in MCRC No.47104/2022.
